ground_truth_format: timestamp tx ty tz qx qy qz qw; world-from-camera; metres; xyzw quaternion

depth_calibration.frame: registered optical camera x-right y-down z-forward
depth_calibration.limitations: Published FR2 source-model research calibration, including its5208 depth units/metre, not independently measured in this environment. Camera RGB distortion coefficients are retained as provenance. Pinhole image projection without distortion correction is an approximation; its validity for source depth registration is not asserted. Native infrared extrinsics and real-vehicle calibration are unavailable; no additional depth range correction is applied.

selection_policy: First candidate FR2 desk fixed original depth indices100..135 declared before metadata acquisition, opaque pixel-byte acquisition, image decoding, sensor fitting or reference numeric pose inspection. Selection used only timestamp and file availability. Each depth observation uses nearest original RGB timestamp with earlier RGB index resolving exact ties and absolute gap<=0.02seconds. All36 depth observations retained, including11 repeated RGB associations; these must explicitly reject without clock renewal. Initial frame100 initializes and all35 following observations are held out. Published5208 source-model profile fixed before opaque transfer and all fits; no GTerror-based calibration selection. Complete SHA256/Gitblob inventories prepared using opaque bytes, without PNG header or pixel inspection. Freeze final algorithms, preprocessing, acceptance, evaluator and independent checker before first pixel decoding and fitting. This is a distinct Freiburg2 camera profile and natural recorded sequence; cross-room generalization and automotive relevance are not established.
